goals.can: I can say hello, goodbye and thank you.
goals.es: ¡Hola! ¿Qué tal? — Bien, gracias.

goals.can: I can say my name and ask someone theirs.
goals.es: Me llamo Mia. ¿Cómo te llamas?

goals.can: I can count from 1 to 10.
goals.es: Uno, dos, tres… ¡diez!

goals.can: I can name colours and animals.
goals.es: El perro es negro.

goals.can: I can name my family and parts of my body.
goals.es: Mi mamá, mi papá… ¡Tócate la cabeza!

goals.can: I can say how I feel.
goals.es: Estoy feliz. Tengo hambre.

goals.can: I can name foods and fruit.
goals.es: Me gusta la pizza. Mi fruta favorita es la fresa.

goals.can: I can talk about a day at the beach.
goals.es: ¡Vamos a la playa!

goals.can: I can name things at school and the clothes I wear.
goals.es: Llevo una camiseta roja.

goals.can: I can name the rooms in my house.
goals.es: La cocina, el salón, mi dormitorio.

goals.can: I can say the days of the week and what the weather is like.
goals.es: Hoy es lunes y hace sol.

goals.can: I can remember the words from my first two worlds.
goals.es: ¡Soy un campeón de español!

goals.can: I can describe myself and other people.
goals.es: Soy alto. Ella es simpática.

goals.can: I can say what I have and how old I am.
goals.es: Tengo un perro. Tengo ocho años.

goals.can: I can say what I like and don't like.
goals.es: Me gusta el chocolate, pero no me gusta el pescado.

goals.can: I can say what I want to do and what I can do.
goals.es: Quiero ir a la playa. Puedo nadar.

goals.can: I can tell the time and describe my day.
goals.es: Me despierto a las siete.

goals.can: I can build simple sentences on my own.
goals.es: Tengo una hermana pequeña.

title: Out and about, then and next

goals.can: I can say what I did yesterday.
goals.es: Ayer fui al parque.

goals.can: I can say what I'm going to do.
goals.es: Mañana voy a nadar.

goals.can: I can order food and ask for the bill.
goals.es: Quiero la sopa, por favor. La cuenta, por favor.

goals.can: I can ask how much something costs.
goals.es: ¿Cuánto cuesta?

goals.can: I can ask the way and follow simple directions.
goals.es: ¿Dónde está el parque? — Todo recto.

goals.can: I can say what hurts.
goals.es: Me duele la cabeza.

goals.can: I can follow a short story in Spanish.
goals.es: Había una vez…

goals.can: I can name places in town and ways to travel.
goals.es: Voy al cole en bicicleta.

goals.can: I can do the food shopping with a list.
goals.es: Una botella de agua y un paquete de pan.

goals.can: I can talk about sports and what I do in my free time.
goals.es: Me encanta jugar al fútbol.

goals.can: I can name farm animals and things in the countryside.
goals.es: En la granja hay muchas gallinas.

goals.can: I can talk about my friends and celebrations.
goals.es: ¡Feliz cumpleaños! Mi mejor amiga es Sara.

goals.can: I can say what people do and what I want to be.
goals.es: Quiero ser astronauta.

goals.can: I can talk about music, art and technology.
goals.es: Toco la guitarra. Tengo un móvil nuevo.

goals.can: I can say I'm ill and describe how I feel.
goals.es: Tengo fiebre. Estoy un poco nervioso.

goals.can: I can give my opinion and compare things.
goals.es: Creo que mi hermano es más alto que yo.

goals.can: I can say what I was doing when something happened.
goals.es: Estaba leyendo cuando llegó papá.

goals.can: I can talk about when I was little.
goals.es: Cuando era pequeño, vivía en Inglaterra.

goals.can: I can join my ideas together.
goals.es: Estoy contento porque hace sol.

goals.can: I can describe my dream house and dream trip.
goals.es: Mi casa ideal tendría una piscina.

goals.can: I can agree, disagree, give instructions and give advice.
goals.es: Tienes razón. Primero coge un huevo. Deberías descansar.

goals.can: I can name the things in my schoolbag and the bathroom.
goals.es: En mi mochila tengo cuadernos y bolis.

goals.can: I can name things in the kitchen and my bedroom.
goals.es: Pongo los platos y los vasos.

goals.can: I can talk about tidying up and chores.
goals.es: Hago la cama cada día.

goals.can: I can use euros and pay in a shop.
goals.es: Tengo cinco euros para gastar.

goals.can: I can use everyday action words and talk about making things.
goals.es: Abro la puerta. Corto el papel.

goals.can: I can talk about the playground and my toys.
goals.es: Me subo al tobogán. Mi juguete favorito es mi peluche.

goals.can: I can play games with friends in Spanish.
goals.es: ¡Te toca! Jugamos al escondite.

goals.can: I can talk about my favourite books and films.
goals.es: Me encanta leer cuentos antes de dormir.

goals.can: I can name zoo animals and sea creatures.
goals.es: En el mar hay peces y delfines.

goals.can: I can name minibeasts and things in the garden.
goals.es: Las plantas necesitan agua y sol.

goals.can: I can talk about the seasons and the sky.
goals.es: En verano hace calor. Después de la lluvia hay un arcoíris.

goals.can: I can name things in space.
goals.es: La Tierra y la Luna están en el espacio.

goals.can: I can describe what I look like.
goals.es: Tengo el pelo rubio y los ojos azules.

goals.can: I can describe my personality and what I like.
goals.es: Soy amable y un poco gracioso.

goals.can: I can talk about my wider family and neighbours.
goals.es: Tengo dos tíos y cuatro primos.

goals.can: I can talk about school subjects and parties.
goals.es: Me gustan las matemáticas y la música.

goals.can: I can count to 50 and greet people politely.
goals.es: Encantado. Hasta luego.

goals.can: I can describe shapes, colours and flavours.
goals.es: Veo una estrella amarilla. El limón es ácido.

goals.can: I can talk about my home and the weather through the year.
goals.es: Hoy hace buen tiempo.

goals.can: I can order in a restaurant and buy clothes.
goals.es: De primero quiero ensalada. ¿Puedo probar esto?

goals.can: I can say what I have done today and this week.
goals.es: Hoy he comido, he jugado y he leído un libro.

goals.can: I can ask and say if I have ever done something.
goals.es: ¿Alguna vez has estado en Madrid? Sí, una vez.

goals.can: I can say how my day has gone at school and at home.
goals.es: Hoy me ha ido bien. ¡Me lo he pasado genial!

goals.can: I can share news and react to it.
goals.es: ¿Sabes qué? Ha nacido mi primo. ¡Enhorabuena!

goals.can: I can say what I did yesterday and last weekend.
goals.es: Anoche cené con mis abuelos y el sábado bailé.

goals.can: I can say what other people did.
goals.es: Mi hermana ganó la carrera y mis padres bailaron.

goals.can: I can tell what happened in order, using time words.
goals.es: Primero nadé, más tarde comí y al final volví a casa.

goals.can: I can choose between «he comido» and «comí».
goals.es: Hoy he nadado, y ayer también nadé.

goals.can: I can say where I went and what it was like.
goals.es: El verano pasado fuimos a Galicia. ¡Fue genial!

goals.can: I can use the most common irregular past verbs.
goals.es: Tuve que estudiar y no pude ir a la fiesta.

goals.can: I can tell someone about a trip or an adventure.
goals.es: Nos perdimos en la montaña, pero por suerte encontramos el camino.

goals.can: I can tell a story and talk about famous people from the past.
goals.es: Picasso nació en Málaga hace muchos años.

goals.can: I can say what I was like and what I used to do when I was little.
goals.es: De pequeño era tímido y jugaba con mi osito.

goals.can: I can describe the past and compare it with now.
goals.es: Antes no había móviles; ahora todo el mundo tiene uno.

goals.can: I can say what was happening when something else happened.
goals.es: Estaba cenando cuando sonó el teléfono.

goals.can: I can tell a fairy tale and talk about holidays in the old days.
goals.es: Érase una vez un lobo que vivía en el bosque.

goals.can: I can talk about my plans for the weekend and next week.
goals.es: El próximo sábado voy a quedar con mis amigos.

goals.can: I can invite someone, and say yes or no politely.
goals.es: ¿Te apetece venir al cine? ¡Me encantaría!

goals.can: I can talk about the future and what I want to be.
goals.es: Cuando sea mayor, seré veterinaria.

goals.can: I can understand a weather forecast and make promises.
goals.es: Mañana lloverá. Te prometo que te ayudaré.

goals.can: I can understand big numbers and prices.
goals.es: Esta bici cuesta doscientos euros.

goals.can: I can buy clothes and say if they fit.
goals.es: ¿Me lo puedo probar? Me queda pequeño.

goals.can: I can shop at the market and order in a café or restaurant.
goals.es: ¿Me pones un zumo de naranja, por favor?

goals.can: I can talk about Spanish food and about money.
goals.es: Me encanta la tortilla de patatas. Guardo mi paga en la hucha.

goals.can: I can talk about transport and buy a ticket.
goals.es: Quería un billete de ida y vuelta a Sevilla.

goals.can: I can ask for and give directions.
goals.es: Sigue todo recto y gira a la derecha. Está al lado del banco.

goals.can: I can stay in a hotel and talk about places in Spain.
goals.es: Madrid está en el centro de España.

goals.can: I can get ready for a trip and ask for help if there's a problem.
goals.es: Perdone, me he perdido. ¿Me puede ayudar?
